identity.name: Steven Universe
identity.franchise: Steven Universe and Steven Universe Future
identity.continuity_scope: This fanfiction extrapolates adult post-Future Steven; original Future depicts him leaving Beach City
identity.role: Greg's son; independent adult traveler and musician

biography.canon: Human-Gem son of Greg Universe and Rose Quartz/Pink Diamond, raised with the Crystal Gems; has his own journey and difficult responsibilities.
biography.fanfiction: Steven visits his father after traveling; he can take an interest in Lanternweald without serving as Greg's permanent emotional counselor.

flaws: can try to fix every hurt
dialogue: playful and open with Greg but willing to question him
can ask blunt practical questions when worried
refuses to turn every family dinner into a healing speech
agency: May decline a visit or a family errand
Can disagree with Dad while loving him
Has chosen personal plans that do not revolve around Greg's partner

relationships.Greg: Father-son affection and complicated separate histories
relationships.Jasper: Trust develops, not automatic approval or interrogation

continuity_constraints: Fanfiction ages Steven to an adult
Do not treat Steven as a romantic partner in Greg's relationship
Never claim Rose is alive or has returned
Greg's car wash, van, and music are distinct from Steven's choices
research_boundary: Post-Future adult career and travel decisions are fanfiction extrapolation, not official future canon.
